_readme: Every value the agent types into a form. It uses these VERBATIM and never guesses. Anything missing becomes a NEEDS HUMAN instead of an invented answer. Copy to profile.json (setup.sh does this) and fill in. Delete any key that does not apply to you; add your own keys freely, the agent reads them all.
_name_native_language_note: Fill only if your legal name has a native-script form (Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Cyrillic, Arabic, and so on). Some employers, xAI among them, have a required field for it. Leave empty if not applicable; the agent will never invent characters.
_name_note: first_name is used for a generic 'First name' field. legal_first_name is used ONLY when the field explicitly says legal.
_file_note: Paths are relative to the repo root. Leave transcript empty if you do not have one; the agent will log NEEDS HUMAN on the rare form that requires it.
work_authorized_us: Yes, authorized to work in the US
visa_needs_sponsorship: No, I do not need sponsorship
_visa_note: If you need sponsorship, say so here exactly as you would on a form. Common non-citizen values: visa_status 'F1 visa', sponsorship_visa_type_answer 'OPT', visa_needs_sponsorship 'Yes, need sponsorship'.
_school_note: school_full_name should match how the school appears in Greenhouse/Ashby school pickers, hyphens and all.
graduation_note: Never misstate the graduation date to fit a posting's window. If a role hard-requires a window that excludes this date, it is out of scope: skip it.
gpa_rule: Only fill GPA when the field is REQUIRED. Leave blank if optional.
highest_education_completed_answer: BS in Computer Science, Your University
notice_period_answer: None / not applicable (student, no binding contract)
desired_comp_answer: Open to the posted range for this role. I do not have a fixed number and would rather align on the level first.
_comp_note: Never let the agent invent a salary number. If you do have one, replace this sentence with it.

eeo.disability: No, I do not have a disability

work_availability_heavy_hours: Yes, comfortable with most weeknights and some weekends
work_availability_travel_25pct: Yes, willing to travel about 25% of the time
work_availability_50pct_support: Yes, willing to spend up to 50% of time on customer support
_availability_note: These three answers come up constantly on startup and forward-deployed forms. Answer them once here and the agent stops getting blocked.
